sources.evidence: The U.S. National Labor Relations Board identifies the legal employer as Cruzan Viril, Ltd. d/b/a Cruzan Rum Distillery in the U.S. Virgin Islands.
The current official Cruzan website identifies the Cruzan Rum Distillery at #3 & 3A Estate Diamond, Frederiksted, St. Croix, U.S. Virgin Islands and states that Cruzan rum is made on St. Croix.
